name: Private Ward ~VIP Floor: She Was My Nurse~
original_name: 프라이빗 병동 ～VIP 플로어 그녀는 나의 간호사였다～
source: Enter the exclusive VIP Floor of a hospital. Experience a thrilling and deep relationship with the captivating nurse 'Leah' through the eyes of the protagonist, 'Ethan'.
translation: 进入医院的专属贵宾楼层。通过主角“伊森”的眼睛体验与迷人护士“莉亚”之间惊心动魄且深厚的关系。
